parsed.rationale: Every member declared in `AudioPlayerProtocol` (`eventStream`, `installRenderTap`, `isPlaying`, `makeAudioBufferStream`, `play`, `removeRenderTap`, `state`, `stateStream`, `stop`) appears verbatim in `TimeShiftablePlayer`, which additionally declares time-shifting-specific members (`isAtLiveEdge`, `maxLookbackSeconds`, `secondsBehindLive`, `seek`, `seekToLive`, `timePositionStream`). This is a textbook protocol-inheritance relationship: `TimeShiftablePlayer` is a strict superset of `AudioPlayerProtocol`. Both protocols live in the same package (`Playback`) and the same directory (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/`), so making `TimeShiftablePlayer` inherit from `AudioPlayerProtocol` requires no cross-package movement and eliminates the nine duplicated member declarations. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false).
